_comment: V2 WIRE REALIZATION LEDGER. Required acceptance artefact of Envelope v2 (Phase G 4.2.6). One row per SEMANTIC EDGE CARRIER. This file declares ONLY realization; the schema's own facts live in a1-f-v2-schema-facts.json, so the gate can compare three independent things instead of checking one file against itself.

_carriers_schema.source: exact source semantic kind, e.g. WorkOrder or CampaignEvent(WorkOrderIssued)
_carriers_schema.target: exact CONCRETE target semantic kind (a meta-target is expanded to its members here)
_carriers_schema.class: Intra | Causal - part of edge identity, not decoration
_carriers_schema.path: concrete v2 wire field path, or the structural commitment that carries it

_carriers_note: Realization is many-to-many: one field may carry several admitted edges, and several fields may carry one edge. Uniqueness is per OCCURRENCE - (source kind, concrete target kind) selects exactly one admitted edge from that field's declared set.
